title: Miso-Glazed Salmon

items: 4 salmon fillets (about 6 oz each, 1 inch thick), skin on or off
1 tsp neutral oil or nonstick spray, for the foil

steps: Set an oven rack 6 inches below the broiler and turn the broiler to high. Line the sheet pan with foil and grease it lightly.
Whisk the miso, honey, soy sauce and vinegar until smooth.
Pat the salmon dry and set it on the foil, skin side down, 1 inch apart. Brush the tops and sides with half the glaze.
Broil 4 min, then brush on the rest of the glaze.

Broil 3–6 min more, until the top is caramelized and the thickest part flakes easily and reads 145°F. Watch closely. If the glaze starts to blacken before the fish is done, cover it loosely with foil.
Serve over rice with cucumber, scallions and sesame seeds.
tips: Thinner fillets (about ¾ inch) cook in about 6 min total, so start checking early.
For deeper flavor, coat the salmon in the glaze and marinate it in the fridge up to 2 hr.
Air fryer: cook at 400°F for 8–10 min, brushing with glaze halfway, until it reads 145°F.
storage: Fridge up to 3 days. Eat it cold over rice, or reheat gently in the microwave at 50% power 1–2 min, or at 275°F for 15 min. Freezing dries it out.
